site.name: Vivek Thakur
site.title: Cloud Architect & Developer
site.about: A Computer Science undergraduate at BITS Pilani and a Cloud Architect at Wipro, working onsite for HPE on private, air-gapped cloud solutions built with HPE GreenLake. I'm passionate about cloud infrastructure, AI/ML and frontend development — and outside of tech I enjoy exploring the universe, photography, and sketching.

projects.title: Major Projects
projects.intro: Things like 'Completed Projects' doesn't exist in my life — I get an idea and start building. There's always something that can be improved, so every project is ongoing.

sideProjects.title: Weekend Projects
sideProjects.intro: Small side projects I built while learning machine learning algorithms — quick experiments, each one shipped as a tiny web app.

exp1.summary: Architecting and implementing a private, disconnected (air-gapped) cloud solution for Hewlett Packard Enterprise (HPE) using HPE GreenLake — delivering secure, scalable infrastructure with zero public internet connectivity while maintaining enterprise-grade capabilities.

exp2.summary: Managed and maintained IBM WebSphere application server environments on-site.

exp3.summary: Administered Windows Server environments with Microsoft Azure and Azure Active Directory as part of an on-site apprenticeship.

exp4.summary: Joined under the Work Integrated Learning Program (WILP) — a scholarship to pursue a BTech from BITS Pilani alongside Wipro's work culture — working with DevOps and Azure DevOps Server.

exp5.summary: Built and shipped responsive web interfaces remotely using HTML5, CSS3 and modern frontend tooling.

exp6.summary: Featured in the Hacktoberfest 2023 Hall of Fame after completing the challenge — contributed to open-source projects with 4 pull requests accepted and merged.

project1.name: IshvaraX
project1.summary: A community platform for people who love to code — open freelance-style projects with applications, study materials organised by topic, a member-written blog, a showcase of shipped apps and an admin panel managing all of it.

project2.name: FIT
project2.subtitle: by IshvaraX
project2.summary: A habit tracker that treats your life like a character sheet — daily tasks earn XP, raise six life stats, and four good days a week level you up. No feed, no ads, offline-first.

project3.name: Saturday
project3.summary: A small framework for building and training your own voice assistant on a small language model — describe a persona, write a few example conversations, optionally add tools, and Saturday handles LoRA fine-tuning, speech in and out, speaker logins, and running the model on a free Colab GPU. Published on PyPI as saturday-ai; JERN is built on it.

project4.name: JERN
project4.subtitle: Just an Experimental Response Network
project4.summary: A personal AI assistant with a cloud-GPU brain and local hands. A fine-tuned Qwen2.5-1.5B model runs on a free Colab GPU while file, shell, web-search and MCP tools execute on your own machine.

project5.name: LAN-Analysis
project5.summary: A Python-based local web app with a React.js UI that analyzes a star topology LAN network, providing details on connected devices, bandwidth usage, network interfaces, Wi-Fi, vEthernet, and DNS server information.

project6.name: LearnIT
project6.subtitle: Open-source book distribution platform
project6.summary: A platform for distributing and accessing open-source books, enabling users to share and discover educational resources.

sideProject1.name: HIRO
sideProject1.summary: Your personal healthcare companion — an ML model that analyzes reported symptoms and suggests likely conditions, wrapped in a simple web UI.

sideProject2.name: ML Image Classification
sideProject2.summary: Groups images that resemble a sample image using ImageNet features extracted with Keras and ranked by cosine similarity — now served as a small web model.

sideProject3.name: TicTacToe AI
sideProject3.summary: An unbeatable Tic-Tac-Toe agent using memoised minimax with a stateless FastAPI backend — ships as a single Vercel function and comes with an exhaustive test proving it never loses.

sideProject4.name: DevBadges API
sideProject4.subtitle: formerly Google Cloud Skill Boost Badges API
sideProject4.summary: Read-only API for showing off a dev profile — Google Cloud Skills Boost badges and GitHub achievements as JSON or embeddable SVG grids, plus a Google weather-card scraper. It powers the badges section on this site.
